children: A day after mogul Barry Diller dropped his bid for the casino operator, the target may have turned the tables. Buying the magazine publisher to get back its $2 billion stake has a bit of strategic logic though the rump isn't worth much. It's a tortured path to get value.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Jennifer Saba on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

MGM Resorts International is mulling an offer for People Inc, according to a September 24 report in the Wall Street Journal, citing people familiar with the matter. People, the owner of the eponymous magazine, has a 27% stake in MGM.
On September 23, People dropped its proposal to buy the rest of MGM for $48.30 per share in cash.
